I don't see how you can complain that Nintendo is dumbing down their games and at the same time insist that they're not targeting kids. DK Country Tropic Freeze, Kirby and the Rainbow Curse, Yoshi's Woolly World; these aren't exactly Dark Souls. It turned out you could only get the power-up to appear after dying five times in a row on the same level (and the item only worked for that level). Even then it was an optional item you had to choose to hit and collect and you weren't punished in any way to continuing to ignore it. I think in some games though, using the item prevented you from getting shiny stars on your save profile as an indicator you never used the power-up.
